name: Pull Request Readiness Panel
purpose: Shows whether repository collaboration work is ready to open or review a pull request.
accessibility: Expose pull request status, title, source branch, target branch, remote branch, review mode, merge policy, checks, evidence, blockers, decision, summary, and next workflow as visible text.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate pull request readiness.
Keep review and merge policy text readable so operators can understand what must happen before main changes.
